subjectTemplate: Your footbag.org profile picture has been removed
bodyTemplate:
Hi {memberName},

An IFPA administrator has removed the profile picture on your account. Your account, your membership and everything else on your profile are unchanged.

Administrator's note:
{note}

You can upload a new picture from your profile edit page. If you believe this was decided in error, you can appeal within 30 days through the contact form on that page, saying which decision you are appealing. An administrator who did not make this decision will review it and reply with reasons.

International Footbag Players Association
